objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving within the policy and guidelines management system.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process at strategic level, such as code of conduct or travel expenses policy.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A regulation describing locally defined rules or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A detailed documentation of specific work steps and procedures within a framework or business process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A non-controlled document attachment that does not require release cycle or dual control approval.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and affects its version.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, or reader.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user who creates and has write access to a document.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user who checks document content for technical and formal aspects during the review step.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user who approves and authorizes distribution of a document to readers.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can view approved documents assigned to them.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and extend the validity period of a document.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic record documenting workflow participant approval of a document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to receive a document or its notifications.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived documents after all other authorizations are revoked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the text and substance of a document using the editing client.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Set or update document properties, attributes, and metadata categories.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Attach an external file or document to a document object.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically transform a document to PDF format after saving.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow to send a document to assigned reviewers for approval.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal compliance.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and authorize a document for distribution to readers.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature to document during workflow approval steps.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw a document from circulation by revoking user authorizations.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Renew the validity period of a document after passing validity review.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it due to lack of continued validity.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore a previously invalidated document to valid status with new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a proposed amendment to an existing released document.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a new document version incorporating an approved change proposal.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Actively confirm receipt and understanding of a released document by assigned user.

evts.name: email_notification
evts.description: Send automated email to users regarding document release, workflow tasks, or status changes.
